test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the middle of the sides. D sits third to the left of F. D sits at one of the corners. C sits second to the right of A. A does not sit at any of the corners. A is not an immediate neighbour of D. G is an immediate neighbour of E. G does not sit at any of the middle of the sides. Only three people sit between G and B.

Who sits second to the right of H?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. 

Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the middle of the sides. 

1) D sits third to the left of F. D sits at one of the corners. 

2) C sits second to the right of A. A does not sit at any of the corners. 

3) A is not an immediate neighbour of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8f84614690c48331a9be733823ea40734be31c199dfa1ab63c848db2caf82e9.png] 

4) G is an immediate neighbour of E. 

5) G does not sit at any of the middle of the sides. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f47d548c77ea6d221557b491c74f67f26f2124572e275739be8b7b40b1935824.png] 

6) Only three people sit between G and B.

And, H will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/329f57027071869bbb9a1d95dc8a8c8d12882d2dc516e1694cbe594ba31a0362.png] 

Here, 'B' sits second to the right of H.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
